gancho: Se subió a un taxi y el chofer sabía su nombre
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Night, inside a taxi with city lights passing outside. ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun) gets into the back seat in a hurry: "A la colonia Roma, por favor. Rápido." The DRIVER (50s, grey mustache, flat cap) looks at her in the rearview mirror: "¿Elena? ¿Elena Torres?"

Same taxi at night, city lights. ELENA (40, dark business suit, low bun) leans forward, suspicious: "¿Nos conocemos?" The DRIVER (50s, grey mustache) removes his flat cap and turns around: "Soy Martín. El que esperaste en el altar hace veinte años."

Same taxi, parked under a streetlight. ELENA (40, dark business suit, low bun) is stunned, tears in her eyes, facing MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, cap in his hands). Elena says softly: "Martín… mi papá me dijo que tú te habías ido." Both realize they were deceived. Slow push-in.
caption: Veinte años creyendo una mentira 🚕💔 ¿Quieren parte 2? #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
